title: fix(app-shell): built-moment transition fires on auto-publish envelopes too (#5799)
body:
Staging verification of #5865 caught the gap: the transition keyed on `draftReview` (drafted-only), but auto-publish environments — the staging/cloud posture — rewrite the whole-app envelope to `status:'published'` (keeping `drafted[]` + `packageId`), so reopening a built conversation stayed on the full page. `detectBuiltAppPackage` reads the raw envelope for either status; new pin drives the published shape end-to-end. 5/5 transition pins + chatbot suites green.
